boundaries: Assessment of representation, not biomedical validity.
M2.5 cross-source matching, mapping adjudication and identity merging remain deferred.
No RDF generation, source acquisition or changes to historical artifacts.
Full-corpus acquisition/freezing remains incomplete; Open Targets 26.06 remains blocked.
Frozen pilot historical/full-release reproduction and uninstrumented-lookup limitations remain applicable.

decisions.informationLossRisk: Case folding, separator replacement, leading-zero removal or URI scheme rewriting changes provenance-bearing strings.
decisions.justification: All eight already satisfy the source reference representation; external identifiers are not OWL identity axioms.
decisions.originalRepresentation: Eight source MONDO:NNNNNNN strings and original http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MONDO_NNNNNNN IRIs; ontology_name mondo.
decisions.targetRepresentation: Preserve exact source spelling and authority-scoped reference; validate ID/IRI consistency without rewriting.

decisions.informationLossRisk: Replacement or text cleanup can erase lexical distinctions even if a reader considers wording equivalent.
decisions.justification: Observed labels already provide the required source wording; no label repair is justified.
decisions.originalRepresentation: Eight present string labels with original case and wording.
decisions.targetRepresentation: Exact original source label; no preferred-synonym substitution, trimming or Unicode normalization.

decisions.informationLossRisk: Flattening, sorting, deduplication, synonym-scope collapse or mapping repair may lose meaning or imply equivalence.
decisions.justification: Nested source-provided annotations already retain their qualifications and are not alignment decisions.
decisions.originalRepresentation: Eight objects for annotation and eight arrays for each other listed field; source order, scope and nested values retained.
decisions.targetRepresentation: Preserve attributed contextual values; do not promote xrefs or MONDO:equivalentTo text into project mappings.

decisions.informationLossRisk: Coercion can collapse absent, null, false, empty string/list/object or different numeric lexemes.
decisions.justification: Extraction already implements the approved lossless representation. Absent top-level fields need controlled tests, not invented source examples.
decisions.originalRepresentation: All ten selected fields present for all eight concepts; typed string, array, object and boolean wrappers. Nested null/empty distinctions retained.
decisions.targetRepresentation: Keep explicit present/absent state and lossless typed values, numeric lexical precision and collection order.

decisions.informationLossRisk: Adding Z or replacing service time with capture time invents context; datetime conversion may truncate precision.
decisions.justification: Capture times already have explicit offsets; unqualified OLS timestamps do not justify an inferred timezone.
decisions.originalRepresentation: Edition 2026-09-01; version IRI; OLS loaded/updated 2026-09-24T00:09:08.017393439 without zone; capture times include +00:00.
decisions.targetRepresentation: Preserve edition, version IRI, service time and encounter time as distinct original lexical values.

decisions.informationLossRisk: Reversal, transitive expansion, deduplication across contexts or exclusion promotion changes the research projection.
decisions.justification: The approved projection is already explicit. No hierarchy closure, endpoint replacement or additional edge is needed.
decisions.originalRepresentation: Five directed accepted OLS parent rows and six separate raw-provenance-only row references.
decisions.targetRepresentation: Keep exact child/parent direction, accepted row pointers, original source context and exclusion disposition.

decisions.informationLossRisk: Replacing source IDs with derived keys or dropping context loses traceability; equal identifiers do not license record merging.
decisions.justification: Source-scoped identity and locators already support exact replay. There is no need for a second dataset.
decisions.originalRepresentation: Manifest digest/commit, original artifact digest, capture and description IDs, request URL, JSON pointer and extraction contract.
decisions.targetRepresentation: Preserve exact lineage and scope; deterministic serialization does not authorize semantic normalization.
